card.name: Drugs that raise blood sugar list
card.fires_on: The word "include" or list commas in the standard sentence about drugs that cause hyperglycemia and loss of glycemic control. It fires as the list of thiazides, diuretics, corticosteroids and similar drugs begins and continues.
